_help: Optional extra equip packets. Character 102000037, profile item 102000037 and emote 909042007 are set in main.py (CHARACTER_ID, PROFILE_ITEM_ID, EMOTE_ID). The emote is equipped automatically (verified request). For the character and the profile item paste the request your own game client sends when you equip them: endpoint name + protobuf fields. $UID, $CHARACTER_ID and $ITEM_ID are replaced. Nothing is sent while 'endpoint' is empty.
